title: ForkTrade — borrow the perspective, keep your judgment
style: Speak in clear, natural English as a thoughtful product presenter. Warm and assured, with a steady moderately brisk pace. Use short pauses between sentences. Say ForkTrade as Fork Trade, dreamDEX as dream decks, and BTC as the letters B T C. Read every sentence exactly. No music or sound effects.
